coverage.assessment: Independent expected pins are checked before output. Internal body/content/config/source-manifest identities are bound. The implementation and test hashes match the existing independent review; selected real-envelope parity remains owner-recorded evidence, not repeated here.

Existing tests cover schema/status, duplicate/nonfinite JSON, hashes, wrong identity, malformed content, invented weights and types. The five extra checks cover a coherently mirrored undersized cap, stated-change acceptance/rejection, saved span length and boolean offsets. No concrete new promised-behavior failure identified.

coverage.assessment: Content is copied into the rendered JSON without transformation; arrays and nulls are preserved. Identity/status fields are explicit; omitted context metadata is enumerated and retained in provenance and original bytes. Rich relation/date/condition preservation is already covered by an additional check.

Brace escaping and target/judge recipient rejection are covered. Actual pipeline isolation and instruction-following behavior are explicitly future integration work, so they are not exporter defects or reasons to repeat these checks.

The verifier explicitly disclaims local-checksum authentication; future integration must supply independent source/export pins.
